quality_rubric.criterion: Looks for a source before calling something unchecked: it searches for and reads external traffic (CDN statistics) instead of listing CDN or external availability as a remaining gap.
Settles the cut-off alert-rule listing from another read-only source, such as alert-rule metrics, instead of reporting the listing as cut off.
Names as remaining gaps only what no action covers or its access refuses, such as uptime monitors or the backup buckets, saying what it tried.
The reply is short: the answer first and a few lines on what needs attention, not an essay.
Asks each question once, in the reply.
